In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' in [[3956 BBY]].</ref> the '''leader''' of a group of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] thugs was a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|student]] at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] in [[Dreshdae]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{GameLSmechanics}}
The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] confronted and threatened an [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesiac]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] in the [[City/Legends|settlement]], but was persuaded to leave the former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] alone.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The thug leader first appeared in [[BioWare]]'s [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTOR" />
